description: This file defines a Java class MessageOnlyLogFilter that implements logging filtering behavior by passing only message content and ignoring other metadata. It is part of a logging framework, intended to be chained with other LogNode implementations.

classes.name: MessageOnlyLogFilter
classes.description: A filter class that processes log messages by passing only the message content downstream, ignoring metadata such as tags or priorities.

methods.name: MessageOnlyLogFilter
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the filter with an optional next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Processes a log message by passing only the message content to the next LogNode, if present.

methods.name: getNext
methods.description: Returns the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: setNext
methods.description: Sets the next LogNode in the chain.
